column1: # MULTIPLE -- `multiple(n)` (G12 phase 4): a number whose value is a whole
# multiple of n, which must be a positive number. Divisibility reads the
# value a number shows: an exact leaf as it is, and a float through its
# shortest round-trip rendering, since binary rounding moves a multiple
# off its divisor. Several divisors accumulate; no least common multiple
# is synthesised. A whole divisor makes the residual integral, so the
# integral gap applies. Every expectation is both engines' agreed answer.
# --- subsume: a divisor is more general than its multiples --------------
